# ios-privacy-label-check
> Free local tool and checklist: compare an iOS app's network traffic (HAR) with its App Store privacy label.
- Paid service: Patterns Lab independent data-flow privacy audit, Standard USD 9,000 fixed, 50% upfront. https://patternslab.work · audit@patternslab.work
- Ongoing monitoring (re-check on each release): price on request.
- Sample report: https://patternslab.work/sample-audit-report
- Scope: technical review only; not certification, pentest, or legal advice.
